Name: MobileDimension
Author: Qingzhi12580
Description:
[color=#e4e4e7]Description[/color]
Fed up with the tiny 12-slot starting inventory? Mining means constant back-and-forth trips to chests to free up space. Want to build a cow barn? You’ll normally need to haul stacks of wood into your backpack first, since vanilla Stardew only reads materials from your inventory.
This portable storage mod fixes both pain points. It adds an unlimited personal stash with one-click deposit & withdrawal and auto-sorting across 13 categories. Crafting, cooking, Robin constructions, Wizard buildings, Clint’s tool upgrades, and barter shops can pull materials straight from the storage.
Items are consumed from your backpack first, then the portable storage for any missing supplies. Gold is always taken from your wallet only.
Tested on Stardew Valley 1.6 Android with SMAPI, compatible with 24 other mods.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install the Android SMAPI launcher for Stardew Valley 1.6 first.[/*]
[*]Download the mod zip file.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder and drop it into your
[code]StardewValley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game using the SMAPI launcher.[/*]
[*][b]Critical[/b]: Empty all items out of the portable storage before uninstalling, or your items will be lost.[/*]
[/list][heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Unlimited portable storage, one-click store / retrieve[/*]
[*]13 item groups with automatic sorting[/*]
[*]Direct material access for crafting, cooking, Robin & Wizard builds, Clint upgrades, and barter trades[/*]
[*]Loot priority: backpack first, then portable storage[/*]
[*]Gold is only pulled from your wallet[/*]
[*]Touch-optimized UI built for Android[/*]
[*]Good compatibility with popular QOL mods[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 (Android)[/*]
[*]Android SMAPI[/*]
[*]Best for single-player. Multiplayer may have sync bugs.[/*]
[/list][heading]Shout outs[/heading]
Huge thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for all the inspiration. Special appreciation to testers who helped iron out Android-specific bugs and polish this mod.
